_comment: The unit of production. Claude generates one of these per video: script split into timed beats, each beat paired with a cinematic visual prompt (9:16), plus the publish package. The render step feeds 'visual' prompts to the video tool and stitches clips under the narration.
topic: What's at the bottom of the ocean's deepest point?
grade: deep teal-and-black, high contrast, cinematic LUT (channel signature)

beats.narration: Seven miles down, the pressure could crush a tank like a soda can.
beats.visual: Cinematic descent POV plunging into pitch-black deep ocean, faint particles drifting past, ominous, 9:16, teal-black grade

beats.narration: This is the Challenger Deep — the lowest point on Earth. It's deeper than Everest is tall.
beats.visual: Slow vertical reveal comparing Mount Everest height to ocean trench depth, dark cinematic infographic feel, 9:16

beats.narration: Sunlight never reaches it. The water is just above freezing, and the pressure is over a thousand times what you feel right now.
beats.visual: Light beam fading to total darkness as camera sinks, lone submersible light cutting the black, 9:16, cinematic

beats.narration: And yet — there's life. Tiny creatures thrive here, feeding on chemicals instead of light.
beats.visual: Macro of translucent deep-sea amphipod on the seafloor, bioluminescent glow, eerie beauty, 9:16

beats.narration: We've sent more people to the Moon than to the bottom of this trench. Most of it has never been seen by human eyes.
beats.visual: Split contrast: astronaut on the Moon vs a tiny submersible in vast dark water, cinematic, 9:16

beats.narration: The deepest part of our own planet is still, mostly, a mystery.
beats.visual: Pull back to reveal the immense black trench below, scale-of-the-abyss shot, fade, 9:16

package.title: What's at the bottom of the ocean's deepest point? 🌊
package.description:
Seven miles down lies the Challenger Deep — deeper than Everest is tall, colder than ice, and almost entirely unexplored. Here's what's down there. 

Follow for one new wonder a day.
package.thumbnail_concept: Dark abyss with a single shaft of light, bold text 'DEEPER THAN EVEREST', tiny submersible silhouette for scale
